page: OVHcloud r3-64 is a memory-optimized cloud instance powered by dedicated AMD EPYC x86_64 processors running under the KVM hypervisor. The instance provides 8 physical cores without multithreading, totaling 8 vCPUs clocked at 2.3 GHz. Each core is backed by 32 KB of L1 data cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and an aggregate L3 cache of 32 MB. It is provisioned with 64.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB RAM-to-core ratio, and includes 200 GB of local NVMe SSD storage alongside a 2 Gbps baseline network connection. Acceleration hardware is not included, and complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not provided by default.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-thread and memory-intensive capabilities. In stress-ng evaluations, the single-core CPU throughput reached 3078.58, placing in the top quartile, while multi-core performance measured 24583.04 within the middle tier. Memory performance is highlighted by a PassMark memory index of 2964.73 and an uncached 256 MB block memory write bandwidth of 101.05 GB/s, both ranking in the top 25%. Read-only bandwidth for uncached blocks reached 172.7 GB/s, paired with a cached throughput of 1185.36 GB/s.

In real-world operational benchmarks, the instance recorded a Geekbench single-core score of 1906.0, a multi-core score of 9709.0, and a Geekbench text processing rating of 2622.0 in the top 25%. PassMark database operations achieved 8636.28, and Redis handled 20.07 million SET operations per second. Static web serving throughput reached 8.61 GB/s. For compact machine learning models, CPU-based LLM inference text generation reached 293.38 tokens per second on a 135M parameter architecture.

The 1:8 core-to-memory configuration and local NVMe storage deliver strong resource density for RAM-sensitive services. However, the lack of AVX-512 extensions and the baseline network rate of 2 Gbps limit deployments requiring high-throughput data replication or vectorized computing. OVHcloud r3-64 is well suited for in-memory caching systems, intermediate relational and NoSQL databases, memory-bound ETL pipelines, and data manipulation workloads.
description: OVHcloud r3-64 is a memory-optimized cloud server driven by 8 dedicated physical AMD EPYC cores at 2.3 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. Equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, it maintains an 8.0 GB per core ratio, supported by 200 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and 2 Gbps network baseline throughput. In benchmark assessments, r3-64 displays strong memory efficiency, recording 101.05 GB/s in large block write bandwidth and a PassMark memory score of 2964.73. Compute throughput is solid, highlighted by a top-quartile stress-ng single-core score of 3078.58 and a Geekbench multi-core mark of 9709.0. Operating without GPU hardware or hyperthreading, the instance delivers predictable single-thread execution and elevated memory capacity, making it a reliable fit for in-memory key-value stores like Redis, relational databases, backend data processing, and analytical ETL pipelines.
